India’s Data Centre Capacity Hits 1.57 GW as Cloud and AI Infrastructure Expand

India's data centre capacity reached 1.57 GW in August 2026 as the government expanded MeghRaj, IndiaAI and domestic cloud infrastructure, with fresh investments, GPU access and data protection measures shaping the country's digital future.
